svg.aria-label: ShopVerse production architecture on AWS for ganga888.in
svg.title: ShopVerse production architecture on AWS for ganga888.in
svg.text: ShopVerse on AWS — production microservices architecture (ganga888.in)
Solid arrows = request / data flow · dashed = control or async flow
Amazon EKS 1.31 — AWS-managed control plane, your worker nodes
namespace shop — 15 microservices (Node.js · Fastify · HPA · PDB · NetworkPolicy)
Order saga (orchestrated by order-service, transactional outbox, idempotent consumers)
order → ReserveStock → inventory → StockReserved → AuthorizePayment → payment → PaymentAuthorized
→ OrderConfirmed → shipping · notification · cart · recommendation · audit
Compensation: PaymentFailed → ReleaseStock → OrderCancelled · 5-min timeout sweeper
Argo Rollouts canary 20% → 50% → 100% with Prometheus analysis (order · payment · catalog)
HPA on CPU/memory for every service · KEDA scales Kafka consumers on lag
Pod Security 'restricted' · default-deny NetworkPolicies · optional Linkerd mTLS
PITR · KMS · one DB per service
15 repos · scan on push · immutable tags
EKS secrets · RDS · S3 · cosign key
IRSA role per service · GitHub OIDC
Delivery toolchain — Jenkins on EC2 in its own CI VPC (10.50.0.0/16), no long-lived cloud keys anywhere
plan on PR · apply on merge
prod needs approval · nightly dev destroy
